6526: Compound describing dimensions: ṣaṭtriṃśat-aṅgula-āyāma (length of thirty-six fingers) and aṣṭa-aṅgula-su-vistara (width of eight fingers).
6527: Compound/phrase: vistāreṇa ca dairghyeṇa (in width and length) sūkara-ānana-sannibham (resembling a boar's face).
6528: Specifies ear dimensions: karṇa-dairghyam (ear length) dvi-mātram (two measures) syāt (should be), vistāram (width) catur-aṅgulam (four fingers).
6529: Alternative measures and feature: tri-mātram vā catur-mātram (three or four measures), tan-madhye (in its middle), bilam ucyate (a hole is called/prescribed).
6530: Instruction on increment: ardha-ardha-aṅgula-vṛddhyā (by increase of a quarter finger), tu (but/indeed), kartavyam (to be made), catur-aṅgulam (four fingers).
6531: Relates sruk and sruva: sruk syāt (there should be a sruk), sruve api (also in the sruva), tad-yoniḥ (its source/origin), tan-mānam (that measure), tatas tataḥ bhavet (should be from that).
6532: Specifies handle dimensions: ṣaḍ-aṅgula-parīṇāhaḥ (six-finger circumference), daṇḍa-mūle (at the base of the handle), ca puṣkare (and at the lotus/bowl).
6533: Describes the ghee receptacle: gopura-ākāra-vat (like a tower/gateway), kāryam (to be made), ājya-sthānam (place for ghee), tad-agrake (at its tip).
6534: Preference rule: nūtanam karaṇam śreṣṭham (a new implement is best), purāṇam tad-abhāvataḥ (an old one in its absence).
6535: Condition for use: tad-ājñā-pūrvakam (preceded by that command/authorization), sa syāt (it should be), tad-bhogya-karaṇam (that implement for use/enjoyment), tataḥ (then).
6536: Establishes precedent: yena śāstreṇa (by which scripture), yat-sthāne (in which place), kriyā pūrvam pravartate (the rite previously proceeds/is conducted).
6537: Rule for gaps: anuktam (what is unstated), anyataḥ grāhyam (to be taken from elsewhere), utsava-ādiṣu karmasu (in festivals and other rites).
6538: Restriction on borrowing: śreṣṭhaḥ tad-dhāma-saṃsiddhaḥ (best, accomplished in that place), na grāhyaḥ anya-ālaya-sthitaḥ (not to be taken if situated in another shrine).
6539: Conditional case: tat-liṅga-ādi-anukūlam cet (if favorable to that sign/emblem etc.), bera-ādyam yat pratiṣṭhitam (whatever image etc. is established).
6540: Prescribes remedy: sthānāt sthāna-antara-prāpti-doṣa-śuddhi-artham (for purification of the defect of transfer from one place to another), ācaret (one should perform).
6541: Specifies the rite: hrasva-prāsāda-mantreṇa (with the short prāsāda mantra), prabhūta-yajana-anvitam (accompanied by abundant worship).
6542: Specifies height range: pañca-ṣaṭ-sapta-hastāni (five, six, or seven cubits), kanyasānām (of the maidens/smaller structures), samucchrayaḥ (height).

6547: Mythic account: sasarja apsarasaḥ (created the apsaras), rudraḥ (Rudra), kauśika-prīti-kāraṇāt (for the sake of Kauśika's pleasure).
6548: States a condition: aspṛśyam (untouchable), pratiloma-ādyaiḥ (by those of reverse order and others), ajāyata (was born/arose), sanātanam (eternal).

6550: fused: tatra-stha.nom.pl.f + muni-patnī.nom.pl.f + asmad.acc.sg + dṛś.abs + sa-ādara-akṣama.nom.pl.f
